This indicates that Doxazosin may influence the metabolic activity of Cyp2c19 through its interaction with Metoprolol, which in turn affects the enzyme's function. The lowest common ancestor of Doxazosin and Metoprolol is the class of compounds known as adrenergic antagonists and organic amino compounds, suggesting a shared biological pathway. The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Doxazosin and Cyp2c19, though the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
